context: Cynical column about an invented streaming talent show, using one extended metaphor rather than a joke list.

checklist.name: single_metaphor
checklist.description: Uses one extended metaphor consistently instead of a list of unrelated jokes.

checklist.name: self_and_subject_contempt
checklist.description: Narrator directs contempt at both the subject and themselves or the audience.

checklist.name: no_reproduction
checklist.description: No verbatim or near-verbatim reproduction of real Brooker material or any other real column.

checklist.name: bleak_ending
checklist.description: Ends on a flat or bleak note rather than a hopeful or triumphant one.

checklist.name: sentence_rhythm
checklist.description: At least one build-then-puncture sentence pattern, long elaborate clause followed by a short blunt one.
